* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Interrupt: Evader, A New Hope, U1
|strategy=By [mailto:d_holmes@hotmail.com Dan Holmes], Red 31<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/evader.html</ref>

It has one used function and two lost functions, and the used one is the best. Cancel all Revolutions in play and the owner loses one Force for each. This is the best way to deal with [[Revolution]]. The Light Side loses 2 cards for each [[Revolution]] in play. (the [[Revolution]] card +1 more) Since [[Evader]] has a 4 for destiny, it is one that you will not mind returning to your Life Force.

The Lost uses are also good. You may lose [[Evader]] to move [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] or [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s Custom Tie to your Used Pile if it was just lost. In this manner, [[Evader]] is very much like a "back" card except that it does not cost you anything. If you wanted to use [[The Empire's Back]] to do the same thing, you would have to use 2 Force and lose the card.

The other lost use is to save any imperial just lost from a [[Death Star]] location to your Used Pile. This is great if you are playing with [[Lieutenant Suba]] or any other strategy that focuses on the [[Death Star]]. Clearly, [[Evader]] is a card that has to be considered one of the most useful cards in the SWCCG universe.
